originalText:
CLAUDE FABLE 5 UPDATE WILL REPLACE MANUAL TRADERS

New update will change everything for devs.

My current bot i made with Claude is still running.

+5,474.62 PnL in a few days.
(started with $100 publicly) 

And it never predicted a single candle to get there.

One dead simple rule: YES + NO < $1.

On a BTC Up/Down market, YES and NO must add up to exactly $1 at resolution.

One side ends at a dollar. 
The other ends at zero.

But the orderbook is messy and both sides trade like strangers.

So for a few seconds YES sits at 47 cents while NO sits at 49.

That's 96 cents to own BOTH sides of a market that pays a guaranteed dollar.

4 cents locked, and it does not care where Bitcoin goes.

The whole game is speed. 

Gaps close in seconds, fees eat the thin ones, and you need both legs filled before it's gone.

Here's where a better model actually changes things for us builders:

It writes tighter execution code.

Meaning less lag between spotting the gap and firing both legs. 

It also catches edge cases a dumber model misses (phantom fills, partial legs, the stuff that turns free money into a loss ).

And it backtests and debugs way faster.

Better model will open the next door for evey arb bot developer.

The gap between button-clickers and builders was already wide.

I guess tomorrow it turns into a smth different.

Check my last articles if you're into arb.

Made them free so our community of builders grow.

Peace.

originalText:
#Fable5用例 之《搭建 AI 生成影片的虛擬拍攝場地》

在 Fable 5 重返之前，分享一個幾乎沒人提過的非常適合用 Fable 5 做的事 —— 低成本做 AI 生成影片的虛擬拍攝場地。

就像是電影有影視城，真人短劇有短劇拍攝基地一樣，現在用 AI 生成影片，你完全可以先寫出影片涉及的所有場景的需求，讓 Fable 5 梳理清楚細節，一步到位直接做出所有場景。

或者更直接一點，把劇本扔給 Fable 5 讓它自己分析場景搭建需求，或者，在已有的文本到視頻工作流中增加如下步驟： Fable 5 分析前面的工作流部分，建模拍攝場景 + 分析不同劇情合適的拍攝手法 → 指定 agent 去場景内完成拍攝和生成參考視頻/圖片 → 結合視頻生成模型去完成最後一步 。

這個前提下，即使你不用 Seedance，你也可以製作出穩定性高、質量不錯的視頻，但如果是做自動工作流，注意審核部分要做好，避免不必要的成本浪費。

做完之後，你可以指定你的 agent 按照你想要的拍攝機位、運鏡手法等，直接讀取場景文件，在建模完畢的場景内部去拍攝視頻或者圖片，配合 prompt，一起喂給視頻生成模型直接渲染場景（或者先走 GPT image2 去渲染成電影級的場景）。

如圖就是我自己做的一組場景的模型内指定機位跟拍截圖和渲染之後的參考圖，我會再放一個視頻片段在評論區參考。

總之，如此一來，你做出來的 AI 影片的場景會非常連貫和符合物理邏輯，不太可能跑偏。

對於宏大世界觀+多部/系列影片的組合，同一個場景只需要做一次，之後都可以復用。

同樣，你也完全可以讓 Fable 5 幫你直接搭建一座覆蓋常見場景的影視城，之後 AI 生成影片的時候，指哪打哪。
對於不同影片來説，當你想換一個佈置風格，僅需再給新的提示詞讓 agent 去處理即可，每個版本做好備份，成本極低。

之所以說很適合用 Fable 5，是因爲用其他模型做這類模型并且持續維護的人力成本非常高。

這麽一來，感覺現實中的拍攝基地會未來會更加空空蕩蕩吧~ 

劇迷以後也不需要去逛影視城，大火的 AI 影視 IP 應該會有自己的 three.js metaverse 可以逛，甚至可以一天換一個主題，設置各種交互（包括直接在其中完成任務獲得限量 NFT 作爲收藏）—— 而這一切在此時此刻都是技術完全支持、可以直接落地的~😂

originalText:
Pemerintah Amerika Serikat mencabut kebijakan kontrol ekspor terhadap model AI Fable 5 dan Mythos 5 milik Anthropic. Akses kedua model AI di Claude akan dibuka pada 2 Juli 2026.

Keputusan ini diambil setelah perusahaan diwajibkan menghentikan akses ke model AI paling canggihnya karena alasan keamanan nasional sejak 12 Juni 2026. "Kami akan mulai memulihkan akses (ke Fable 5 dan Mythos 5) besok, dan bakal bagikan kabar terbarunya segera," tulis Anthropic di akun X resminya.

Berdasarkan bocoran surat internal yang diperoleh Reuters, Menteri Perdagangan AS, Howard Lutnick, menyatakan kebijakan larangan akses global Fable 5 dan Mythos 5 telah dicabut sehingga Anthropic tidak lagi memerlukan lisensi untuk mengekspor model-model tersebut.

Lutnick menjelaskan pencabutan dilakukan setelah Anthropic menyepakati sejumlah komitmen keamanan. Anthropic berjanji akan secara proaktif mendeteksi dan menangani risiko keamanan yang berkaitan dengan model AI mereka.

Anthropic juga akan bekerja sama dengan pemerintah AS dalam menyusun protokol dan standar peluncuran untuk Mythos, Fable, maupun model AI generasi berikutnya.

1/ The Fable 5 cycle on X is comedy writing itself.
Before the restrictions hit: Timeline was flooded with “I built this entire game/app/SaaS with Fable 5”, wild demos, and “one prompt and it cooked” posts. Everyone was locked in and shipping.
2/ Restrictions drop → instant rage + open source awakening.
“Closed models are a trap.”
“We need sovereign AI now.”
“Time to go local and never rely on these companies again.”
The revolution was trending for like 18 days.
3/ Anthropic announces Fable 5 is back tomorrow… and I think the rage tab will be closed.
The same accounts that were ready to burn closed models to the ground may be back to posting “Fable 5 just built my whole product in 3 prompts” by Wednesday. Demo videos loading. Principles on pause.
4/ This loop is gonna keep repeating until an open source model actually beats Fable 5 (or the next frontier model) and stays better for more than one news cycle.
Until then the “open source or death” movement is just seasonal content that expires the second the shiny toy comes back.
AI Twitter has the memory (and principles) of a goldfish with a trending audio. 😂
Who else is calling it?
#Fable5 #OpenSourceAI

originalText:
HAPPY @claudeai FABLE 5 / MYTHOS 5 EVE:

20 MCP connectors to have wired for Claude Fable 5 ⚡

Fable's edge is long-running agentic work, so the connectors that let it *act* matter more than the ones that just answer.

🔥 The Popular 10 (you already know these)

1. GitHub — repo-scale migrations + multi-file refactors, the flagship pairing

2. Google Drive — docs/sheets straight into context

3. Slack — read threads, post updates, live where your team is

4. Linear / Jira — backlog → actual PRs

5. Notion — wikis + project DBs as a memory layer

6. Sentry — real error traces into a self-correcting debug loop

7. Postgres / Supabase — query + mutate your DB mid-build

8. Figma — design-to-code context

9. Stripe — revenue/customer data for ops + analysis

10. Puppeteer / Playwright — vision-only browser autonomy

🕵️ The Deep Cuts 10 (underrated, punch above their weight)

11. Exa / Tavily — agent-native search built for retrieval loops, not keyword dumps

12. Firecrawl — turns any site into clean structured markdown

13. Apify — 4,000+ prebuilt actors, instant scraping/automation

14. Chroma / Qdrant — vector memory so Fable recalls across long sessions

15. Browserbase — headless cloud browsers that survive long agent runs

16. E2B — sandboxed code execution, run what it writes safely

17. Cloudflare — deploy Workers, edit DNS, manage KV/R2 from chat

18. AWS — provision + manage infra directly in an agent loop

19. Ref / Context7 — live library docs so it stops hallucinating APIs

20. Todoist — task capture + management the agent can drive
